question: How can a participant react on the shared todo assignment?

youtubeLink.caption: Participant React Assigned Todo
youtubeLink.description: This video explains how a participant can react on the shared todo assignment

sections.beforeHtml: A participant reacts on assigned shared todos directly in the Shared todos list. The reaction controls only appear when the current participant is the assigned person for that row.
items: Open Trip > Shared todos for the selected trip.
Find a row assigned to you. Plantour shows Accepted and Rejected checkboxes only on rows you are allowed to react to.
Click Accepted if you agree to take responsibility for that todo. Plantour then creates a personal trip todo for you from that shared todo.
Click Rejected if you do not want to take responsibility for that todo. Plantour marks the assignment as rejected.
If you uncheck Accepted, Plantour removes the personal accepted todo that was created for you.
If you reject a todo that you had already accepted, Plantour clears the accepted link and removes the personal accepted todo from your trip todos.
Plantour notifies the admin when you accept or reject the assignment.
sections.afterHtml: Accepting is the bridge from the shared-planning page to your own personal work page. After acceptance, continue with What can a participant do after accepting the todo assignment?.
